claim_scope: conditional prediction complementarity of the delivered seed-7 TCN with one own fold-0 lineage-parent GRU prediction, measured only on the frozen exposed fold-0 evaluation groups

selection_history.selection_reason: Root requested a conditional-value check after the TCN standalone grade was seen.
selection_history.interpretation: This is adaptive discovery analysis on an exposed fold, not confirmation. Every preregistered blend outcome will be reported without selecting a winner.

reference.role: own public-incumbent-lineage parent prediction; this is not the full public submission endpoint

split_manifest.exposure: exposed discovery fold; not fresh confirmation

comparison_design.mask: need_prediction AND is_scored; need_prediction is row index >= 99 in every sequence
comparison_design.metric_formula: For each target, clip target and prediction to [-2, 2], weight rows by abs(clipped target), pool all selected rows, compute weighted Pearson correlation; wp is the arithmetic mean of t0 and t1.
comparison_design.blend_formula: p = (1 - alpha) * parent_prediction + alpha * tcn_prediction; blend raw outputs first, then apply the official metric clipping.
comparison_design.reporting_rule: Report the official score and delta from alpha=0 for every alpha; do not choose or promote the best weight.
comparison_design.pair_covariance_and_correlation: For each target separately on the same selected rows, clip each member prediction to [-2, 2], weight by abs(clipped target), and report weighted population covariance and Pearson correlation between TCN and parent outputs.

uncertainty.method: paired component bootstrap over frozen group-level official metric moments
uncertainty.comparisons: Each alpha blend versus the alpha=0 parent; report every interval, including the zero self-comparison.
uncertainty.interpretation: Conditional on fixed predictions and exposed fold-0 components; excludes training-seed and public-transfer uncertainty.

comparability_limits: The TCN is a fresh raw-only scratch model; the parent is a GRU256x2 trained with the team's own since teachers and fold-0 propensity model.
This measures conditional prediction complementarity against one own lineage parent on an exposed fold; it is not a matched family or compute-controlled comparison.
stopping_rule: Verify prediction and lineage hashes, evaluate only the exact frozen fold-0 468-group mask, report all five fixed blends, per-target weighted pair covariance/correlation, and paired component bootstrap versus alpha=0; do not tune, add slices, or report an all-data/public forecast.
